name: Enchanter

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: A wizard specializing in influencing minds. Some features are reference-only; see each feature’s implementation status.

feature.name: Enchantment Savant
feature.summary: Add Wizard spells of this school to your spellbook for free: two of level 1–2 at Wizard level 3, then one of a level you can cast on gaining a new spell slot level.

feature.name: Enchanting Conversationalist: Proficiency
feature.summary: Choose Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion proficiency.
feature.text: Choose Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion proficiency.

feature.name: Enchanting Conversationalist: Bonus
feature.summary: Checks using the selected skill add your Intelligence modifier, minimum +1. This additional bonus is reference-only.
feature.text: Checks using the selected skill add your Intelligence modifier, minimum +1. This additional bonus is reference-only.

feature.name: Hypnotic Presence
feature.summary: Magic action: one visible creature within 10 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC. Failure Charms and Incapacitates it with Speed 0 for 1 minute, ending if it takes damage, leaves 10 feet, or can neither see nor hear you. Uses equal Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.

feature.name: Split Enchantment
feature.summary: When casting an Enchantment spell with a slot that can add a target by upcasting, increase its effective level by 1. Uses equal Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.
feature.text: When casting an Enchantment spell with a slot that can add a target by upcasting, increase its effective level by 1. Uses equal Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

feature.name: Instinctive Charm
feature.summary: Reaction when a visible attacker within 30 feet hits you: Wisdom save against your spell DC. Failure makes the attack miss you and redirect, with the same roll, to another creature in its reach other than the attacker; you choose if several qualify. Once per Long Rest; casting an Enchantment spell with a slot restores use.

feature.name: Alter Memories
feature.summary: When casting a slotted Enchantment that Charms, choose one target to remain unaware of your influence. Once before the spell ends, a Magic action forces an Intelligence save; failure erases up to 1 + Intelligence modifier hours (minimum 1), capped by the spell duration.
